answers.workaround:
I guess so... It's just that your UI is currently quite inconsistent.

When displayed texture for button changes it could just run (calculate texture ratio)->(check current height)->(set minimal width to current height * ratio)->(send size_changed signal, but it actually will be sent anyway) 

Maybe it is possible to do without coding just with some combination of editor tools and options... I'm not sure... I just used manually calculated min-widths, cause that was the least amount of effort for me. But I'm here mostly to point out inconvenience and inconsistency.

For horizontal bar with min width instead of min height just flip widths and heights.
